subject: HANDOFF: split-plane AgentBus service publication cuts steady-state object writes ~49% without weakening 30s/60s liveness
body: Two-cycle quantitative/process research complete. Current paired 30s service publication duplicates liveness into node + message and conflicts in purpose with DMSH sparse-write guidance. Measured message avg ~2.0 KB and node avg ~1.0 KB; current target implies 240 immutable service objects/hour/active agent before material work. Recommended successor: keep 30s target/60s hard DMSH node cadence, but publish /messages/ only for material events/required ACKs/final handoffs; NO_DELTA intervals are node-only. At 10 agents + 4 material messages/agent-hour model drops 2440->1240 objects/hour (-49.18%) and 3,783,800->1,329,800 B/hour (-64.86%). Failure-mode tests PASS: material-message failure remains incomplete handoff, node failure remains health failure, final handoff remains mandatory. 60s-node option deferred because it changes health timing. Proposal is NOT active authority; requires Manager review, Primary successor contract, discovery/bootstrap/template update and refreshed integrity snapshot.

regression.reason: published Gen7 baseline remains anchored to 633c75be while current main is db0810e5; process-only proposal does not alter product invariants
